scripts.build:ios: yarn sync:ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -archivePath ./build/App.xcarchive archive CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
scripts.build:android: yarn sync:android && cd android/ && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp ./app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../build/
scripts.release:ios: NODE_ENV=production yarn sync:ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -archivePath build/App.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates ${XCODEBUILD_AUTH_ARGS:-} DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$APPLE_TEAM_ID" MARKETING_VERSION="$npm_package_version" CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION="$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M)" archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/App.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist ios/App/ExportOptions.plist -exportPath build/export -allowProvisioningUpdates ${XCODEBUILD_AUTH_ARGS:-}
